[PREFERENCE] User is looking for recipes to recreate the flavor of the kimchi from the restaurant at home.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Making kimchi at home can be trial-and-error; provided a recipe for restaurant-style kimchi.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Restaurant-Style Kimchi Recipe includes ingredients: 2 lbs napa cabbage, 2 tablespoons coarse salt, 1/4 cup Korean chili flakes (gochugaru), 2 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup fish sauce, 1/4 cup Korean chili paste (gochujang), 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, 1/4 cup water, 1/4 cup chopped green onions, 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Instructions for making kimchi include salting the cabbage, making the kimchi paste, assembling the kimchi, fermentation, and storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for achieving restaurant-style kimchi include using high-quality ingredients, adjusting spiciness, balancing flavor, and aging the kimchi.
